design: Independently remove a*n times local, inherited or total MLP factorial interaction at adjective-last-subtoken or period at layers0-4. Native prompt replay with targeted output replacement, all later positions/layers recomputed. Identity and paired norm-matched random factorial output edits for each site/component.
downstream: Record projections of attention5 mixed source values onto their native factorial interaction at adjective/period and final-token attention5 output onto its native interaction. Quartet signed average gives retained projection fraction; may exceed1 or be negative. This is a tracking diagnostic, not full causal mediation.
limits: Teacher-informed quartet output edits can be off-manifold. Same-panel site scan with onlyfour native-competent familiar formatA quartets; failed cohorts retained, not filtered. No training or reserved test.
